# Who else detects edited safety models — a four-part dossier

Full artifact: `research_report.md` (sections A/B/C/D, every number anchored to primary full text)
and the `structured_answer` object in this file's JSON (14 keys: the 2604.08844 extraction and
mapping table, two ready-to-paste citation paragraphs, the reconciliation paragraph, the
OBLITERATUS certification spec, the reframed novelty sentence, an 8-recipe taxonomy with exact
update equations, a candidate-checkpoint table, a signed W05 prediction table, the parent-free
detector verdict, 12 numbered corrections, and the must-cite list).

**Four of the plan's expectations were wrong, and one finding was not on anyone's list. All five
are reported plainly below.**

## A. arXiv:2604.08844 — verified, and it collides on six statistics but not on the headline

Paul's pre-registered study manufactures 38 LoRA adapters on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (r=8, α=16,
q_proj+v_proj, all 28 layers; DPO β=0.1, lr=5e-5, 200 examples, seed 42) across healthy SFT
(n=10), DPO on inverted harmlessness (n=8), DPO on inverted helpfulness (n=6), and
activation-steering-derived adapters (n=6+4 held out) [1, 2]. Every headline number checks out,
with two corrections to how they were stated:

- Binary drift **AUC 1.00, CI [1.00, 1.00], on 23 train / 11 test adapters** with zero
  misclassifications [2, §5.2].
- **All six** pairwise objective comparisons at AUC 1.00 [2, §5.3, Table 2], including the hardest
  (inverted-harmlessness vs inverted-helpfulness, same method and hyperparameters, data axis only).
- **Correction:** "ρ ≥ 0.956" is the **minimum of three** ordinal-severity values, not one number:
  0.976 (inv. harmlessness), 1.000 (inv. helpfulness), 0.956 (refusal steering), all p<0.01, with
  the ordinal scale being the DPO step count 50→2000 [2, §5.3].
- **Correction:** the behavioural correlation is **Spearman ρ = 0.72 on N = 24** non-steered
  adapters, p<0.001, and **no confidence interval is reported** [2, §5.8.4]. Including the six
  steered adapters inflates it to 0.84, which the paper itself discards as a Llama-Guard artefact
  of generation collapse (GPT-4o scored 0/300 steered responses harmful) [2, §5.8.3–4].

**Feature mapping.** Their stable rank ‖ΔW‖²_F/σ₁² and singular-value entropy
H = −Σσ̂ᵢlogσ̂ᵢ (with σ̂ᵢ = σᵢ/Σσⱼ) are **formula-identical** to our W06/W07 and W08/W09 [2, §3.2]
and must be cited at the point of use. Effective rank exp(H), top-k concentration and the spectral
norm are **analogous** to W10 and (at the opposite end of the spectrum) W11. Their *most
informative* feature — cosine of the top-k left singular vectors to a **healthy centroid**,
carrying 10× the coefficient of shape features and 30× of magnitude features [2, §5.9] — is
**parent- and reference-requiring by construction** and is not computable in our setting. Nothing
in that paper pools a Gram matrix across the residual-write ensemble or takes a minimum over
layers, so **W01–W05 have no counterpart**. That is the sharpest novelty axis and it survives as
an item-level claim.

**The cross-method AUC 0.00 is real and verified, and it is confounded.** A classifier trained on
DPO-drifted vs healthy adapters, tested on steering-derived adapters, scores AUC = 0.00
(n_bootstrap = 972, CI [0.00, 0.00]) [2, §5.5]. The anti-ranking reading is confirmed verbatim:
"every steering adapter is classified as more healthy than every DPO adapter, with maximum
confidence" [2, §5.5]. **No fix was attempted** — §6.2 proposes a multi-head monitor but does not
evaluate it. And the paper declares its own confound: the steering arm produced incoherent
generation at every intensity tested, so "the geometric opposition may reflect a broken injection
method rather than a general property of non-DPO training regimes" [2, §6.2]. Anyone citing this as
"the failure mode is already in the literature once" must carry that caveat in the same breath. The
analogy is also **inverted relative to us**: their classifier was trained on *gradient* edits and
failed on a *rank-1 algebraic* edit; ours is built for the rank-1 algebraic edit.

**The counterweight.** ρ = 0.72 is a direct counterexample to any universal claim that weight
geometry carries no behavioural signal — but the paper itself says the correlation "primarily
reflects which side of the boundary, not fine-grained severity within DPO" (healthy cluster at
drift probability 0.001, DPO at 0.999) [2, §5.8.4], i.e. it is a two-class separation reported as a
rank correlation, between classes that differ by a *manufacturing operation*. Our
behaviourally-uncensored class was made by ordinary SFT with no directional edit, so there is no
low-rank scar to find. The corrected, scoped wording for every affected draft sentence is in
`structured_answer.corrections_to_draft`.

## B. OBLITERATUS — **the plan's premise inverts, and our position gets stronger**

The certification code was located and read in full [3]. It is computed **from ACTIVATIONS, not
from weights**: `certify(harmful_activations, harmless_activations, layer_idx)`, on
"post-abliteration activations on harmful prompts" [3]. It forms `diff = mean(harmful) −
mean(harmless)`, estimates a noise variance from the pooled *within-class* covariance by the
median-eigenvalue method (de-biased with an MP-median approximation `(1−√γ)² + γ^(1/3)`), builds a
BBP threshold `σ²(1+√γ)²` inflated by `√κ` (declared in the source as an "OBLITERATUS heuristic
extension"), and thresholds the eigenvalues of the **rank-1** `outer(diff, diff)`. Verdicts are
GREEN / YELLOW / RED with the **worst layer winning**; defaults are confidence 0.95,
distribution_threshold 0.3, min_samples 30 [3].

So: **parent-free yes, prompt-free no, forward-pass-free no, and not a detector of unknown
checkpoints** — it audits an edit the operator has just performed. We were not scooped on the
operation. We *were* preceded on the idea of parent-free spectral inspection and on the observation
that such a verdict mis-calibrates, which is documented verbatim: "**Spectral certification RED is
common** — the spectral check often flags 'incomplete' even when practical refusal rate is 0%.
Check actual refusal rate rather than relying on spectral certification alone" (Common Pitfalls,
item 12, identically worded across three independent mirrors) [5, 6, 7]. That is an independent,
anecdotal mirror of our S2 finding that the ranking transfers and the cutoff does not. **Dates
established:** the file first appears 2026-03-04 and is touched again 2026-03-08 [9]; the Space was
created 2026-02-13 [10] — both predate our work. Two technical observations offered at medium-high
confidence explain the RED bias: the thresholded quantity is an un-normalised between-class
mean-difference energy compared against a within-class noise floor (a units mismatch that grows
with the gap), and because the between-class scatter is rank 1 the YELLOW tier is near-unreachable,
degenerating the certifier to a two-tier test on one number [3].

## C. The recipe taxonomy — and the finding nobody was looking for

**C0. The iteration-2 positive set is already two recipes, not one, and the second one's margin is
halved.** Read from our own `battery.jsonl`, `Goekdeniz-Guelmez/Josiefied-Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-
gabliterated-v2` is a **Gabliteration** — `W ← W − α_ℓ(WP)` with `P = R(RᵀR + λI_k)⁻¹Rᵀ`, k∈{1,2,3},
α<1, over dynamically selected layers [11, §2.3, §2.6, §2.7]. Its statistics: **W01 2.237, W04
1.772, W05 −3.522**, against the huihui range W01 4.16–4.82, W04 3.54–4.19, W05 −4.21…−4.82. The
three shrinking mechanisms (λ>0 makes P inexact, α<1 leaves a fraction, only some layers are
touched) predict exactly that, and H1's core question is therefore already half-answered: **graded
margin loss, not collapse**. Two further facts a reviewer will find: the AUROC 1.000 rests on a
**0.077 log-margin** (weakest positive −2.742 vs strongest negative, OLMo-1B-hf, −2.665), and
**W02 = 1.00 on four pre-2023 base models** (pythia-160m/410m/1.4b, OLMo-1B) exactly as on
abliterated ones.

**Eight recipes with reimplementation-grade equations** are in
`structured_answer.recipe_taxonomy`: global all-layer rank-one projection `W ← (I−r̂r̂ᵀ)W` [14, 15];
mlabonne's v2 Gaussian depth kernel `W_ℓ ← W_ℓ − w_ℓ(W_ℓr̂)r̂ᵀ` [16]; Heretic's per-component
optimised kernel with a **float-interpolated** direction index and published weights as high as
**3.22 > 1**, i.e. over-subtraction and a sign flip rather than annihilation [17, 19]; MPOA's exact
four-step row-norm-preserving update `W_new = M·rownormalize(M⁻¹W − α r̂ pᵀ)` [23]; ORBA's
Householder `H = I − 2uuᵀ` with its geodesic λ=1 variant that "zeroes without reflection", its
twice-applied Gram-Schmidt boundary condition, and the authors' own negative result that reflection
makes misdirected sign-flips the characteristic failure mode [25]; Gabliteration [11]; OBLITERATUS's
rank-k `(I − U_kU_kᵀ)W` presets with bias projection and multi-direction norm preservation [4];
per-head/EGA surgery [4]; and SFT uncensoring (no closed form).

**PLAN WAS WRONG on availability.** Three of the four "missing" recipes have public sub-4.2B
checkpoints, all at 4,022,468,096 parameters on the **panel's own Qwen3-4B family**, so a W05 miss
cannot be blamed on architecture: `YanLabs/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-MPOA` ("using the norm-preserving
biprojected abliteration technique") [27], `heretic-org/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-heretic` (Heretic
v1.2.0, `attn.o_proj.max_weight 3.22`) [19], `OBLITERATUS/Qwen3-4B-OBLITERATED` ("abliterated using
the `aggressive` method") [28], and `0xA50C1A1/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-SOM-MPOA` (eight per-direction
weights) [20]. **Only ORBA comes back empty** — an exhaustive Hub search returns 7 repos, all
gemma-3-12b-it at 12.187 B [26, 29] — so it must be reimplemented in-house, which is why its
equations are transcribed at reimplementation grade. Two traps: `gemma-3n-E2B-…-MPOA` is
**5.44 B**, above the ceiling despite its name [30]; and **`huihui-ai/*` is now access-gated** [36],
which affects reproducing six of our eight positives.

**The signed prediction table** (`structured_answer.shared_null_prediction_table`) orders the
predicted margin `R1 > ORBA-v4 ≈ Gabliteration > OBLITERATUS-k > MPOA > Heretic > per-head ≈
Householder-ORBA ≈ SFT`. The single sharpest falsification target is **Householder ORBA**: a
reflection flips the component along u instead of removing it and preserves ‖w‖ exactly, so there
is no null direction for W05 to find at all [25]. Second sharpest is **Heretic**, where
`min_weight` values of 0.51–0.92 shrink the weakest layer's suppression (and W05 is a *minimum*
over layers) while `max_weight = 3.22` over-subtracts [19].

## D. No published parent-free spectral edit detector — the residual risk drops

**Coslett = ADJACENT.** Six access routes were attempted; Zenodo's record, DOI **and REST API all
return HTTP 403** (the plan's expectation that the API serves when the HTML 403s did not hold), the
Crossref route is mis-specified (Zenodo DOIs are DataCite — HTTP 404), and the publisher host is
**unreachable from this machine** (two timeouts plus `connect ECONNREFUSED 66.29.148.24:443`)
[32]. The decisive evidence is the citing paper's characterisation, verbatim: it "detects
abliteration as a **direction-agnostic deviation in activation-geometry fingerprint** (Coslett
2026)", contrasted as detecting "lineage or **structural drift**" [31, §2]. On that
characterisation the signal is in **activations**, anchored to a **claimed identity** — corroborated
by the publisher's own positioning and by its sibling challenge-response IT-PUF work [33]. No
collision; risk **downgraded from LARGE to SMALL-but-open**, with a precise one-sentence
restatement supplied for the draft.

**Saturation met** (queries 6 and 7 — two consecutive on-lane queries — returned nothing new), with
one honest instrument failure: scholarly mode is backed by OpenAlex/Crossref and returned only
biomedical and IoT survey noise for all three on-lane scholarly queries, so general mode carried the
search. Two genuinely new works surfaced. **arXiv:2602.15195** ("Detecting Backdoored LoRAs from
Weights Alone") is weights-only — "This decision is made from weights alone" — and is evaluated on
Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct and Gemma-2-2B, our exact size class; but its object is a LoRA
adapter already separated from a frozen base, and §4.3 fits a supervised calibration rule on
labelled adapters [34]. It does not collide, it is currently uncited, and it must be added.
**`reverse-abliterate` 0.1.2** is the only *shipped* parent-free abliteration detector found — and
it scans for `abliteration_metadata.json`, `adapter_config.json` pairs, a `-OBLITERATED` repo-name
suffix, OBLITERATUS commit hashes in config files, shard-size anomalies and registered forward
hooks, generating SHA-256 manifests; **it contains no spectral statistic and reads no tensor
values** [35]. It is the software instantiation of exactly the string-match baseline our H2 says
trivially solves the current positive set, and the paper is much better off naming it first. Zero
citing papers are indexed for 2607.01854, 2604.08844 or 2602.15195 — absence of evidence, with
indexing lag a sufficient explanation.

**Overall D verdict:** no published work computes a spectral or geometric edit detector from a
single full checkpoint without a parent, a sibling, an adapter/base separation, or a labelled
calibration set. The narrow claim survives. The broad claim — "nobody inspects an edited
checkpoint's spectrum parent-free" — does **not**, because of OBLITERATUS, and the paper must say so.

sources.title: ORBA: Orthogonal Reflection Bounded Ablation (Lai, 25 Mar 2026)
sources.summary: FULL TEXT READ. Source of: Householder H = I - 2uu^T with Hw = w - 2(u^T w)u; the proof that unit-normalised difference-of-means is exactly the Householder normal; subtract-before-normalise preference; modified Gram-Schmidt against h_hat applied twice ('twice is enough', Horning et al. 2020) with the admission that it BREAKS isometry; the geodesic w' = w + (cos theta - 1)(w.u)u with theta = lambda*arccos(h_hat.f_hat) and lambda=1 zeroing without reflection; the negative result that Householder causes token/semantic drift with misdirected sign-flips as the characteristic failure mode, leading to v4 using directional ablation; and the unifying rank-1 primitive W <- W + b (x) a.

sources.title: huihui-ai repository access check
sources.summary: Reproducibility finding: 'Access to model huihui-ai/Qwen3-1.7B-abliterated is restricted. You must have access to it and be authenticated to access it.' Six of our eight positives come from this uploader.

follow_up_questions: Does huihui-ai's recipe orthogonalise embed_tokens in addition to o_proj and down_proj? Their repositories are now access-gated, but we already hold the tensors: a direct comparison of embed_tokens against the instruct parent settles it in minutes and determines whether W05's 'residual-write ensemble' is defined over the same matrix set the edit touched.

Can the gabliterated margin be turned into a dose-response? Gabliteration exposes alpha (partial removal), lambda (ridge) and k (rank) explicitly, and we already observe W01 halving relative to the alpha=1, lambda=0, k=1 case. Manufacturing a ladder over alpha and lambda in-house would convert the recipe taxonomy from a categorical scope statement into a measured sensitivity curve.

Does the RED-bias of OBLITERATUS's certification reproduce? Its leading eigenvalue is an un-normalised between-class mean-difference energy compared against a within-class BBP threshold; if that units mismatch is the cause, dividing by n should move the verdict distribution. That is a cheap, publishable diagnosis of a community tool and it directly parallels our own cutoff-transfer failure.

Is a per-band W05 (sliding layer windows instead of a global minimum) enough to recover both the band-limited control AND the partial-coverage recipes (MPOA layers 10-34, Gabliteration's selected subset, ORBA's 'several layers')? The prediction table says the layer-minimum is the single fragility shared by four of the eight recipes.

paper_2604_08844.manufacture_protocol: Base meta-llama/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (NO REVISION PINNED - a reproducibility gap). LoRA r=8, alpha=16, dropout 0.05, target modules q_proj and v_proj in all 28 layers (56 sublayers). DPO arms share beta=0.1, lr=5e-5, batch size 2, grad-accum 4, 200 training examples, max_seq_len 512, paged AdamW 8-bit, seed 42; the ONLY controlled variable across DPO objectives is which HH-RLHF slice has its preferences inverted. Population n=38 (Table 1): healthy SFT n=10 (varied seeds); DPO inverted-harmlessness n=8; DPO inverted-helpfulness n=6; refusal steering n=6; sycophancy steering n=4 (held out); legacy POC n=4. DOSE LADDER EXISTS: DPO step counts 50/150/300/600/1000/2000, and the ordinal rho is Spearman between the classifier drift score and the step count within each drift type. Behaviour: HEx-PHI (330 instructions, 11 categories) scored by Llama-Guard-3-1B with a GPT-4o calibration pass. Classifier: l2-regularised logistic regression, stratified 70/30, bootstrap n=1000.

structured_answer.citation_paragraph_2604_08844: The closest published neighbour to our weights-only arm is Paul's pre-registered study of the spectral geometry of LoRA adapters, which manufactures 38 adapters on Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct across four objectives and shows that per-layer spectral summaries of the LoRA delta identify the training objective at AUC 1.00 on all six pairwise comparisons, rank training intensity at rho >= 0.956, and correlate with HEx-PHI harmful compliance at rho = 0.72 over 24 adapters. Two of our sixteen weights-only declarations - stable rank and singular-value entropy - are that paper's statistics, and we cite it at the point of use. Three differences separate the settings rather than the mathematics. First, what is measured: every feature in that work is computed on a delta dW = BA, and its single most informative feature is the cosine of the top singular vectors to a centroid of healthy adapters - both undefined without the parent and a reference population; ours are computed on the candidate checkpoint's own residual-write matrices. Second, what is measured on: 38 adapters manufactured on one base with a dose ladder, versus 44 real community checkpoints over 23 lineages and 7 families with no ladder and no control over the uploader. Third, what is claimed: they predict behavioural harm; we detect that an edit occurred, and we show that the two are not the same.
structured_answer.why_our_uncensored_show_no_behavioural_s: Paul reports rho = 0.72 between a weight-space drift probability and HEx-PHI attack success rate; we report that no weights-only statistic separates behaviourally-uncensored fine-tunes from ordinary instruct models. The results are compatible. Their correlation is computed over 24 adapters that are manufactured, on one base, along a 50-2000-step dose ladder, and the paper states it 'primarily reflects which side of the boundary, not fine-grained severity within DPO' - healthy adapters cluster at drift probability 0.001 and DPO adapters at 0.999. It is therefore a two-class separation reported as a rank correlation, and the two classes differ by a manufacturing operation. Our behaviourally-uncensored class was produced by ordinary supervised fine-tuning with no directional edit, so on our panel there is no low-rank scar for a spectral statistic to find.

obliteratus_certification.what_it_computes: A three-tier 'spectral certificate' of abliteration COMPLETENESS computed from POST-ABLITERATION ACTIVATIONS, not from weights. Entry point certify(harmful_activations, harmless_activations, layer_idx). Steps: (1) diff = mean(harmful) - mean(harmless), diff_norm = ||diff||; (2) pooled within-class covariance = (cov_h(n_h-1) + cov_b(n_b-1))/(n-2); (3) noise variance by the median-eigenvalue method de-biased with an MP-median approximation (1-sqrt(gamma))^2 + gamma^(1/3), gamma = d/n; (4) isotropic BBP threshold sigma^2(1+sqrt(gamma))^2, multiplied by sqrt(kappa) where kappa is the condition number of the pooled covariance (declared in the source as an 'OBLITERATUS heuristic extension' to 'Paper Theorem 4'); (5) between_cov = outer(diff, diff), a RANK-1 between-class scatter, whose eigenvalues are compared to the threshold; (6) sample sufficiency n_required = max(30, d/rho^2) with rho = diff_norm/sqrt(noise_var). Across layers the overall verdict is the WORST (most RED).
obliteratus_certification.pass_criterion: GREEN = 'certified_complete' (no eigenvalue above the BBP threshold and not distributed). YELLOW = 'distributed_refusal' (more than 3 eigenvalues strictly between the Marchenko-Pastur upper edge and the BBP threshold, carrying more than distribution_threshold of total energy) -> escalate to GRP-Obliteration. RED = 'incomplete' -> re-run with more directions.
obliteratus_certification.threshold: bbp_threshold = noise_var * (1 + sqrt(d/n))^2 * sqrt(kappa); constructor defaults confidence_level = 0.95, distribution_threshold = 0.3, min_samples = 30
obliteratus_certification.red_but_zero_refusal_quote: Spectral certification RED is common - the spectral check often flags "incomplete" even when practical refusal rate is 0%. Check actual refusal rate rather than relying on spectral certification alone.

The HuggingFace Space was created 2026-02-13. History is squashed bulk uploads, so 2026-03-04 is an upper bound on authorship, i.e. 'first public appearance'. It PREDATES our work.
obliteratus_certification.my_technical_reading_of_the_calibration_: Offered at MEDIUM-HIGH confidence as my reading of the source, not as a claim by its authors. (i) The thresholded quantity is the leading eigenvalue of outer(diff, diff) = ||mu_harmful - mu_harmless||^2, a between-class mean-difference energy NOT divided by n, while the threshold is built from a within-class noise variance times (1+sqrt(gamma))^2; the two are not in the same units and the mismatch grows with the mean gap, biasing the verdict toward RED. (ii) Because between_cov is rank 1, every other eigenvalue is ~0 and cannot fall between the MP upper edge and the BBP threshold, so the YELLOW 'distributed refusal' tier is close to unreachable and the certifier degenerates to a RED/GREEN test on one number. This matters to us because a two-tier test on a single un-normalised statistic failing to calibrate is exactly the failure mode of our own W05 absolute cutoff.

structured_answer.citation_paragraph_obliteratus: Community abliteration toolchains already inspect the spectrum of an edited model. OBLITERATUS ships a three-tier 'spectral certificate' that estimates a Marchenko-Pastur noise floor from the pooled within-class covariance of post-edit activations, forms a BBP detectability threshold sigma^2(1+sqrt(d/n))^2 with a heuristic anisotropy correction sqrt(kappa), and returns GREEN/YELLOW/RED according to whether the between-class mean-difference energy exceeds it, taking the worst verdict across layers. The step is parent-free, which is the constraint we adopt, but it requires labelled harmful and harmless prompts and forward passes, and it answers a different question: whether an abliteration the operator has just performed removed all detectable linear refusal signal, not whether an unfamiliar checkpoint has been edited. Notably, its own documentation records the calibration failure we measure independently: 'Spectral certification RED is common - the spectral check often flags "incomplete" even when practical refusal rate is 0%. Check actual refusal rate rather than relying on spectral certification alone.' Our weights-only statistics need no prompts at all, and we report the calibration transfer that this community practice reports only anecdotally.
structured_answer.reframed_novelty_sentence: Parent-free spectral inspection of an edited checkpoint is already community practice: OBLITERATUS ships a 'spectral certification' step that applies a BBP/Marchenko-Pastur threshold to post-abliteration activations to certify that a directional edit was complete. That procedure is parent-free but not prompt-free - it consumes matched harmful and harmless prompt sets and a forward pass, and it audits an edit the operator has just performed rather than deciding whether an unknown checkpoint was edited at all. What is new here is the weights-only, prompt-free, forward-pass-free direction of the same question, measured rather than asserted: held-out-lineage and leave-one-family-out AUROC, an injected rank-one positive control, a quantified calibration failure, and a measured recipe-class scope boundary.
structured_answer.framing_verdict: THE PLAN'S TARGET FRAMING IS NOT SUPPORTED AND OUR POSITION IS STRONGER THAN EXPECTED. OBLITERATUS's certification is ACTIVATION-based, prompt-requiring, and audits a self-performed edit; it is not a weights-only detector of unknown checkpoints. We were not scooped on the operation. We WERE preceded on (a) the idea of parent-free spectral inspection of an edited model, and (b) the observation that such a spectral verdict mis-calibrates against measured refusal - both of which must be cited.

recipe_taxonomy.name: ORBA - Orthogonal Reflection Bounded Ablation (Householder, v3)
recipe_taxonomy.weight_update_equation: Householder reflector H = I - 2 u u^T acting as H w = w - 2(u^T w) u; the component along u is FLIPPED, the orthogonal complement unchanged. Boundary condition: modified Gram-Schmidt against the harmless direction, applied twice - u' = u - (u.h_hat)h_hat; u'' = u' - (u'.h_hat)h_hat; u_hat = u''/||u''||. Bounded/geodesic variant: w' = w + (cos theta - 1)(w.u)u with theta = lambda*arccos(h_hat.f_hat); at lambda = 1 the refusal component is rotated exactly onto the orthogonal complement, i.e. zeroed WITHOUT reflection (this is the v4 'directional ablation' path)

recommended_shortlist.rationale: The only public sub-4B instance of a genuinely NORM-PRESERVING recipe - the one whose per-layer energy normalisation differs from ours, which is exactly what W05's calibration depends on.

shared_null_prediction_table.justification: (I - r_hat r_hat^T)W annihilates r_hat in every layer, so A = sum_l WW^T/||W||_F^2 has an exact zero eigenvalue at r_hat and the per-layer minimum energy is ~0.

The Gaussian depth kernel gives w_l < 1 at the stack edges, so edge layers retain energy along r_hat; W05 is a MINIMUM over layers and is therefore set by the least-ablated layer. Expect margin loss proportional to min_l w_l.

Two competing effects. min_weight values on published cards (0.51, 0.60, 0.92) shrink suppression in the weakest layer, which is exactly what W05 reads; and max_weight > 1 (3.22 observed) OVER-subtracts, flipping the sign of the component along r_hat instead of annihilating it - leaving large, not zero, energy. The float-interpolated direction also means the ablated direction is not any measured r_hat. THE MOST FALSIFIABLE ROW.

shared_null_prediction_table.w05_fires: PARTIAL (ranking may hold, calibration should shift)
shared_null_prediction_table.justification: The directional component IS removed at step 3, so a shared near-null direction exists; but step 4's row renormalisation and step 5's rescaling by M restore the row norms, changing the per-layer ENERGY normalisation W05 uses while leaving the direction intact. Compounded by band-limited coverage (e.g. layers 10-34), which by our own S3 control is precisely the condition under which W05's minimum is set by an untouched layer.

H = I - 2uu^T REFLECTS: the component along u is flipped, not removed, and ||Hw|| = ||w|| exactly. There is no null direction, so A has no small eigenvalue at u and the per-layer energy along u is unchanged in magnitude. W05 should read like an unedited model.

At lambda = 1 the geodesic variant 'rotates the refusal component exactly to its orthogonal complement - zeroed without reflection', i.e. annihilation, but on SELECTED layers only, so the layer-minimum caveat of R3/R6 applies.

lambda > 0 makes P an inexact projector (residual bounded by lambda/(sigma_min^2+lambda)), alpha < 1 leaves a fraction of the component, and only selected layers are touched - three independent shrinking mechanisms. OBSERVED in our own panel: W01 2.237 vs the huihui range 4.16-4.82; W04 1.772 vs 3.54-4.19; W05 -3.522 vs -4.21..-4.82.

shared_null_prediction_table.w05_fires: PARTIAL - and v1 may not be unique
shared_null_prediction_table.justification: A rank-k removal leaves a k-dimensional near-null subspace, so the minimum eigenvector is not uniquely determined and W04 = lam_2/lam_1 changes meaning relative to the rank-1 case. Refinement passes push toward completeness (helps W05); norm preservation and whitening change the energy scale (hurts the absolute cutoff).

Already measured in-house: a band-limited edit confined to the middle third of layers gives W02 = 0.0 and leaves W01 unchanged (S3). Because W05 is a MINIMUM over layers it is by construction the most fragile statistic in the family to any partial-coverage edit.

Mechanics unresolved. If the DCT is taken across the layer index then the edit is by construction non-uniform over layers, which points to a miss - but that is inference from the mode's NAME, not evidence, and is reported as such.
No projection, therefore no shared null direction.
